risk_note: RV2 payout (withdraw lane B2-06d; model Claude Fable 5.1). The payout process's transfer job (queue payout, name transfer; BR-WDR-13 ①–⑤, 14, 17, 28, 09; W5 / W6 / W9): ① the withdrawal is read under FOR NO KEY UPDATE and left alone unless PAYING with the payload's execute_seq; ② any kind=transfer attempt → no transfer, only the first query job (singletonKey id:seq:query:0, delay query_schedule.points_min[0] × 60); ③ inside pg_advisory_xact_lock('payout_daily:' + app_id) the pure review (payout_disabled → queue_paused → channel_disabled → member_blocked under users → balance locks → single_cap on net_fen → daily_cap = Σ net_fen of today's (+08:00, @couli/domain) pending / success / unknown transfer attempts of the app over every channel) and W9 by CAS on row_version (hold_reason, hold_at, executor cleared, batch and seq kept, wallet.withdrawal_changed; member_blocked also enqueues one negative-balance recheck that payout.module wraps into the event envelope); ④ the pending attempt is inserted as couli_payout and committed while the lock is held, so it is visible before ⑤ and the lock is released before ⑤; ⑤ one channel.transfer outside any transaction, never rethrown, never repeated. Landing: the attempt completed once (response / codes / result / latency); success → PAID_API with channel_order_id and paid_at plus the WITHDRAW:SUCCESS:CASH_<channel> voucher wd:{id}:PAID (zero fee / tax lines omitted) on one transaction under users → balance locks; definite fail → FAILED with fail_code and WITHDRAW:RETURN wd:{id}:RETURN; payer side → W9 payer_side_after_transfer, payout.queue_paused through content's system write port and the payout_queue_paused alert; unknown (transport or unlisted code) → stays PAYING, first query job, pause and alert only for an unlisted code. A CAS that moves 0 rows only warns; a landing database error still enqueues the first query job or rejects for the queue's redelivery (② then only queries). Amounts are bigint fen through @couli/money; instants only from the injected Clock; logs carry ids and codes, never the payee.
